Enemies

Enemies are the entities that you will be fighting in the game. They have a set amount of health that towers and units can reduce until it reaches zero, whereby the Enemy is killed.

As the game progresses, stronger, and sometimes faster, Enemies will spawn. Some will even have special abilities to aid other Enemies, while others can attack your towers and units, affecting them in a negative way.
